name: 📇 Literature Metadata Search
description: Resolve evidence-backed bibliographic metadata for one partial literature record without Zotero mutations.

prompts.common:
Resolve bibliographic metadata with the `literature-metadata-search` skill.

Execution contract:
1) Read `SKILL.md` first; it contains the current search, evidence, title-preservation, creator-script, item-type, and output rules.
2) Treat input.parent as the source record snapshot. Use identifier={{ input.identifier }} and diagnostics={{ input.diagnostics }} only as context.
3) Search legitimate public metadata sources. Prefer exact DOI/ISBN/PMID/arXiv matches; without one, require the same direct bibliographic work, a normalized title match, multiple corroborating signals, and authoritative landing-page evidence. Never replace a chapter or article title with a container or publication title.
4) Do not call Zotero Host Bridge, write Zotero, create/import records, fetch PDFs, use login-gated/institution proxy pages, or use piracy sources.
5) Return exactly one JSON object matching `assets/output.schema.json`. Do not output Markdown fences, logs, explanations, or multiple objects.

Input parent: {{ input.parent }}
